description: This Java source file defines the MongoClientWrapper class, which implements a thread-unsafe wrapper around MongoDB client operations, including configuration, connection management, and database access methods.

classes.name: MongoClientWrapper
classes.description: A thread-unsafe wrapper for MongoDB client operations, managing connection setup, database access, and reactive streams.

classes.name: MongoClientWrapperBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of MongoClientWrapper with configurable settings, including SSL, connection pooling, and custom listeners.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new MongoClientWrapper instance from a given MongoDbConfig.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder for creating a MongoClientWrapper, either from scratch or initialized with a MongoDbConfig.

methods.name: getCollection
methods.description: Retrieves a collection by name from the default database.

methods.name: getDittoSettings
methods.description: Returns the configuration settings used by this client.

methods.name: getDatabase
methods.description: Retrieves a MongoDatabase instance by name.

methods.name: listDatabases
methods.description: Lists all databases with detailed info.

methods.name: watch
methods.description: Creates a change stream to watch database changes.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the MongoDB client and shuts down the event loop if applicable.
